in_hebrew.name: מיכה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מיכה הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'מי זה כה אלוקים' או 'מי הוא כאלוהים'. השם מורכב משתי מילים: 'מי' שפירושו 'מי' ו-'כה' שפירושו 'כמו' או 'דומה ל'. השם מיכה מוזכר במקרא כנביא שפעל בתקופת המלכים האחרונים של יהודה.

in_greek.name: Μιχάς
in_greek.long_meaning: Μιχάς είναι ένα ελληνικό όνομα που προέρχεται από το εβραϊκό 'מיכה' και σημαίνει 'Τίς ὡς θεός' ή 'Ποιος είναι όπως ο Θεός'. Το όνομα Μιχάς αναφέρεται στην Αγία Γραφή ως προφήτης που έζησε κατά την εποχή των τελευταίων βασιλέων της Ιουδαίας.

in_latin.name: Micha
in_latin.long_meaning: Micha est nomen hebraicum quod significat 'Quis ut Deus' vel 'Quis est sicut Deus'. Nomen Micha invenitur in Scriptura Sacra ut propheta qui vixit tempore regum ultimi Iudaeae.

in_english.name: Micah
in_english.long_meaning: Micah is a Hebrew name that means 'Who is like God?' or 'Who is like the Lord?'. It is derived from the Hebrew words 'mi' meaning 'who' and 'cha' meaning 'like' or 'similar to'. In the Bible, Micah was a prophet who lived during the reign of the last kings of Judah. The name Micah has been used in Christian tradition to signify a person who is devoted to God and seeks to emulate His character.

biblical_reference.note: The Book of Micah is a prophetic book in the Old Testament that contains the messages of the prophet Micah.

data.cultural_impact: The name Micah was popular in the Hebrew Bible and was borne by several impressive figures including a prophet and aribe chief in ancient Israel. The name was also common among early Christians. Micah has a rich cultural heritage, which is often celebrated in biblical studies, literature, and art.
data.spiritual_significance: Micah is a name that encourages us to ponder on God's greatness and to remember that there is none like Him. It serves as a powerful reminder of God's sovereignty and divine essence. For many Christians, the name Micah is a constant reminder to turn to God in times of uncertainty and to seek His guidance and wisdom in all aspects of life.
